variants.title: B-H curve and hysteresis loss of hard steel
variants.aim: Trace the B-H loop of a hardened steel ring on an oscilloscope, drive it to saturation, and read its coercivity, its retentivity and the hysteresis loss per cycle from the loop.

source.title: Hardened carbon steel loop values (coercive field of order 4 kA/m, saturation about 2.0 T)
source.note: from memory - verify against Cullity and Graham, Introduction to Magnetic Materials, or Bozorth, Ferromagnetism
